notes: The only unrepresented token is the assimilated article of בַּשִּׁטִּים, which the ASV renders anarthrously (rules 12, 29).

לִזְנוֹת is split as written: the לְ takes the written *to* (rule 52) and the infinitive takes *play the harlot* whole, headed on *harlot* by rule 44's light-verb test; the *the* belongs to that one rendering rather than being a separate determiner.
בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב has no article morpheme, so the construct takes a supplied *the* and the name takes the relational *of* (rules 19, 29).
